items.title: 52300_Trummy Young oral history interview
items.q: when this kid was born Eubie U.B. was 75

ctx.x: Yeah, we did a movie of it. And it was the most beautiful thing you ever heard in your life. People were coming out of there crying. I mean many people with tears in their eyes. It was amazing. And here's this guy -- so, Dick got up there and announced. And said, well, when this kid was born Eubie U.B. was 75. It's so funny. It's so funny. You know, you wouldn't think it would work but it did.
It was beautiful. Everybody was talking about them when they came away. That's going to be -- I'm sure that's going to be one of the highlights of the movie. It would have to be. It was amazing.
